coaching.headline: Crunch's seventeen kills opened the map, and four of six won fights became towers, a Mini Prime and the duo inhibitor.

flags.text: Crunch led all ten in kills, hero damage and objective damage, and scored all five Kaelen deaths.
Six enemy structures fell to zero allied; Murdock razed two, Lt. Belica one, Crunch the duo inhibitor.
Sparrow and Riktor died six times before minute ten, four to Crunch; the allied duo had zero.
The draft ran one tank, Steel, against three; teams two tanks down won 46.7% in ranked.

focus.title: Fight, then siege
focus.action: Keep the winning order: after a won fight, hit the nearest tower before resetting, and in grouped fights let Steel's Shield Slam open so Murdock and Lt. Belica land damage inside the stun.

12.8.call: Won five to zero across the duo lane, mid and the enemy jungle, then Murdock razed the enemy duo outer; the enemy scored no kill after this fight.

15.3.call: Crunch took four kills while Lt. Belica razed the enemy mid outer, and Murdock razed the mid inner after. Pressing a second tower off a clean fight was correct.

19.7.call: Genesis Core went allied, then five enemy deaths in the enemy base, on the duo lane and on the offlane, and Crunch razed the duo inhibitor right after.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Zero deaths and 10,806 damage mitigated at 25% kill participation. If Kaelen or Riktor engages Murdock, spend Bull Rush to knock the engager away first.
Wards ran 11 against a 17.3 norm, one fewer than Riktor. With Rift Walkers raising the ward cap to three, keep three wards up before each Fangtooth or Mini Prime.
8027fc05-883b-490c-970a-5d2080acd3d1: Razed the enemy duo outer and mid inner, the most recorded structure kills of all ten, with one death. When Sparrow is dead, push the duo tower before rotating.
Hero damage 517 a minute against a 1070 norm. Static Trap roots trigger Crush; then land three quick basic attacks on the same hero for Vermis.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Zero deaths against a personal norm of 2.1, and scored three of Aurora's four deaths. While Hoarfrost is down, keep diving Aurora with Assault The Gates.
One assist, fewest among allies, with hero damage 699 a minute against a 555 norm. Once the enemy offlane outer falls, bring Stone Forged Soul to the next mid fight.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Zero deaths, a game-high level 15 shared with the jungler, and the enemy mid outer razed mid-fight. Before each Mini Prime, drop Void Drone near the pit for vision.
Hero damage 394 a minute against a 761 norm. With Noxia built, follow each Seismic Assault hit with Void Bomb on the same hero to trigger Dark Matter.
Killed Aurora on the offlane seconds before Crunch razed the duo inhibitor. Once the mid outer falls, keep hunting side-lane picks during pushes.
a8fc2666-226f-4cfe-8300-62adb007a1e0: Fucking monstrous: seventeen kills, 31,697 hero damage, 47% of the team total, and 23,259 objective damage. Keep invading the enemy jungle whenever Kaelen is dead.
Two of three deaths went to Wraith in the enemy jungle, one outside any detected fight. Before the next invade, bring Lt. Belica when Wraith is missing from mid.

matchup: Steel into Riktor wins 48.7% over 876 field games; here the allied duo had no deaths before minute ten.
Riktor's Skewer suppresses and Shock Therapy silences; Riktor fell seven times, five to Crunch and two to Steel.
build: Forticus shields on taking hero damage and adds max health during hero combat, suiting a frontline support.
Tainted Charm, finished last, cuts the healing of nearby enemy heroes and slows; Kaelen healed 7,593, the most on the enemy side.
eternal: Krix adds max health and size; Cannibalism grows max health on takedowns, Regenerative Tissue regenerates away from hero damage.
Idrisil leads a toss-up of Steel support Eternals with Nihil and Knell; Krix, the most played, trails Idrisil, Nihil and Knell.
Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism is the best Krix pair in the Steel support field. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Heavy Metal adds bonus magical damage on-hit to Heavy Punches and Shield Bash, scaling with total armor.
Heavy Metal and Adaptive Force are a toss-up in the Steel support field. Sound keep.
crest: Rift Walkers' Rift Snatcher dashes forward and pulls nearby heroes toward Steel.
Rift Walkers leads a toss-up with Leafsong in the Steel support crest field. Sound keep.
improvement: No unmet need into Riktor; the best Steel core is Xenia, Dynamo, Vanguardian at 67.2% in 58 games, unbuilt.
Idrisil for Krix is the field's toss-up lead: armor while healthy and a shield at low health, giving up bonus max health.

matchup: Murdock into Sparrow wins 47% over 701 field games; Sparrow finished 1/6/1, two deaths to Murdock.
Sparrow's Heightened Senses grants stealth and attack speed; Sparrow's lone kill was Murdock's only death.
build: Vanquisher executes heroes taken below a small health threshold.
Necrosis adds Ultimate Haste and more ultimate damage, feeding Long Arm of the Law; finished last, absent from earlier fights.
eternal: Vermis adds max-health damage on every third consecutive basic attack on one hero; Crush pays off Static Trap roots.
Thraex leans first in the Murdock carry Eternal field; Vermis ranks last of four options with enough games.
Serration with Melting Point is the best Vermis pair; Crush with Melting Point has too few games to rank.
augment: Martial Law makes Long Arm Of The Law hit harder and pay bonus gold on hero kills.
Justice's Reach is the clear Best in the Murdock carry augment field; Martial Law ranks last of three.
crest: Pacifier dashes and empowers the next physical hit, far stronger on low-health targets, with a recast after hero kills.
Pacifier is the clear Best crest in the Murdock carry field. Sound keep.
improvement: Physical armor into Sparrow was the listed need and NOT built; with one death, no armor gap is proven here.
Into Sparrow the most played core is Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher, Imperator at 55.9% in 143 games; Necrosis sits off the core.
Justice's Reach over Martial Law is the field-backed swap: Shots Fired pierces units with extra range, giving up ultimate damage.

matchup: Greystone into Aurora wins 49.6% over 334 field games; Aurora finished 0/4/0 here.
Aurora's Hoarfrost roots and Cryoseism stuns; Aurora led the enemy with 13,505 hero damage.
build: Overlord cleaves around basic-attack targets and stacks permanent health on kills.
Tainted Bastion reduces the source's healing whenever Greystone takes magical damage; Greystone took 10,389 magical hero damage.
Tainted Bastion finished last; until then Greystone's anti-heal came from Tainted Oath's Blight on Sacred Oath.
eternal: Krix grows max health and size; Cannibalism adds max health on takedowns.
Nihil and Krix are a toss-up in the Greystone offlane Eternal field. Sound keep.
Voracity with Cannibalism is the best Krix pair; Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism trails.
augment: Tainted Oath makes Sacred Oath apply Blight to enemies.
Imperial Soul and Tainted Oath are a toss-up in the Greystone offlane augment field. Sound keep.
crest: Saphir's Mantle's active grows size and max health, damages nearby heroes, then keeps part of the damage as max health.
Saphir's Mantle leads a toss-up in the Greystone offlane crest field. Sound keep.
improvement: No unmet need into Aurora; the best Greystone core is Overlord, Rapture, Aegis Of Agawar at 58.2% in 564 games.
Overlord matched the core; Rapture and Aegis Of Agawar were not built.
Voracity for Regenerative Tissue matches the best Krix pair: health and gold per unit kill over regeneration away from hero damage.

matchup: Lt. Belica into Wraith wins 52.9% over 143 field games; Wraith finished 2/6/0, one death to Lt. Belica.
Wraith's Surprise, Surprise! grants camouflage and the Sonar Drone reveals nearby enemies; Wraith killed Crunch twice.
build: Combustion splashes damage on ability hits; Noxia marks a hero on ability damage, and a second ability triggers max-health damage.
Combustion and Noxia are the first two items of the most played core into Wraith.
eternal: Aion grants mana regeneration per cast and gold from spell damage to heroes; Runic Focus turns current mana into magical power.
Lotus leans first in the Lt. Belica midlane Eternal field; Aion ranks fourth of five options with enough games.
Bottomless Vial with Arcane Resonance is the best Aion pair; Bottomless Vial with Runic Focus trails.
augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience that grows with hero level.
Combat Veteran is the clear Best in the Lt. Belica midlane augment field. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's active grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed.
Soulbearer leads a toss-up with Epoch and Typhoon in the Lt. Belica midlane crest field. Sound keep.
improvement: No unmet need into Wraith; the most played core into Wraith is Combustion, Noxia, Wraith Leggings at 60.8% in 51 games.
Wraith Leggings next: abilities deal 12% bonus magical damage to heroes below 40% health, sharpening burst on low targets.
Lotus for Aion is the field lean: random stat gains over time and on takedowns, giving up spell gold.

matchup: Crunch into Kaelen wins 46.3% over 242 field games; here Crunch took 110 minions from the enemy jungle.
Kaelen's Frostfall roots in an area and Rimefang stuns; Riktor's Skewer suppresses.
build: Berserker's Axe and Vyzar Carapace add 15 ability haste apiece, cutting top-rank Re-Crunch to about 15.4 seconds by game end.
After Forward Crunch's dash, the empowered basic attack stacks Berserker's Axe's hit with Rapture's on-hit damage and Vyzar Carapace's Scorn.
Rapture finished last; earlier fights ran without Rapture's on-hit damage and omnivamp.
eternal: Nihil grants power and armor while damaging heroes, growing on level-ups and takedowns; Terror cuts minion, monster and tower damage.
Nihil has too few Crunch jungle games to lead; Thraex is the most played, with no edge claimed.
Growing Threat with Adaptive Plating is the best Nihil pair; From the Abyss with Terror has too few games to rank.
augment: Combo Crunch stacks attack speed whenever Cross Crunch deals damage.
Lunge Crunch and Combo Crunch are a toss-up in the Crunch jungle field. Sound keep.
crest: Iceskorn Talons' active lays an ice sheet: allies on the sheet gain physical power and speed, enemies are slowed.
Judgement and Brutallax lead a toss-up in the Crunch jungle crest field; Iceskorn Talons trails Judgement and Brutallax.
improvement: No unmet need into Kaelen; the best Crunch core is Berserker's Axe, Augmentation, Draconum at 60.6% in 66 games.
Berserker's Axe matched the core; Augmentation and Draconum were not built.
Judgement for Iceskorn Talons stays on the same crest path: area damage that heals on hero hits, giving up the ally sheet.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.5s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
ourKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
ourKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
ourKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

ourKits.combo: Root a target with Static Trap, shred armor with Buckshot, stack attack speed with Hot Pursuit and finish with the long-range Charged shot or Long Arm of the Law.
ourKits.winCondition: Control space with traps and out-range enemies with Charged basic attacks, then snipe low targets anywhere with Long Arm of the Law.
ourKits.passive: Shots Fired: after 5 landed basic attacks his next one gains extra range and bonus damage.
ourKits.playWith: A frontline or peeling support, since his only escape tools are Buckshot's push back and Hot Pursuit's speed.
ourKits.playAgainst: Avoid fighting over Static Traps and engage after Buckshot is used, since it is his push-back peel. Stay out of the ult line at low health; armor does not help against Long Arm of the Law.

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
ourKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
ourKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
ourKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
ourKits.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
ourKits.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
ourKits.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
enemyKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
enemyKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
enemyKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

enemyKits.combo: Rimefang to stun, slow and lay Rimeglass, Winter's Pursuit onto the Frostbitten target to root them, Razorstorm on Rimeglass, then Frostfall to crash down and root the center.
enemyKits.winCondition: Fight on his Rimeglass, where Razorstorm boosts his armor and Frostbite deals max health true damage and sets up Winter's Pursuit roots.
enemyKits.passive: Heart of Ice makes his abilities leave Rimeglass that slows and burns enemies with Frostbite.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow up on his roots and Frostfall.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root you. Frostfall channels before he leaps, so move out of the center of the landing and leave the Rimestorm; tenacity helps against the roots.

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! to mark, reveal and slow → Knock, Knock! snipe on the marked target → Back It Up! to drag a fleeing hero back
enemyKits.winCondition: land Knock, Knock! on Peekaboo!-marked targets for max-health damage and reset Surprise, Surprise! on takedowns
enemyKits.passive: his vision item becomes a camouflaged Sonar Drone that reveals enemies through walls
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds targets still for his snipe, and teammates who follow up when Back It Up! returns a hero
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Peekaboo! since Knock, Knock! is much stronger on marked targets; after Back It Up! teleports you back, expect a follow-up, and pressure him after Surprise, Surprise! is spent

enemyKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
enemyKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
enemyKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

enemyKits.combo: Riplash to pull a hero in, Shock Therapy to break their shield and silence, Electrocute aura for damage and a shield, then Skewer to suppress everyone in front of him.
enemyKits.winCondition: Land Riplash and chain silence and suppress so the target cannot fight back while their cooldowns stay frozen.
enemyKits.passive: Suspended Sentence: while his abilities immobilize or silence a hero, their cooldowns stop ticking.
enemyKits.playWith: Burst that deletes his pulled or suppressed target.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Stay behind minions or spaced so Riplash cannot reach you, and fight while it is on cooldown. Tenacity shortens the chain, which also shortens the cooldown freeze.

loadout.name: Combo Crunch
loadout.text: Dealing damage with Cross Crunch grants 7.5% Total Attack Speed for 3s, stacking up to 4 times.

ability.name: Cross Crunch
ability.what: After casting an ability, Crunch amplifies his next basic attack to deal (+28%)(+30%) bonus magical damage and reduce his current cooldowns by 1s.

loadout.plain: Each empowered punch after an ability stacks attack speed. Weave ability, punch, ability, punch to keep the stacks up and land more hits between casts.

loadout.name: Nihil
loadout.text: Damage a hero to gain Doom for 3s. Doom grants 1 Physical Power, 2 Magical Power, 1 Physical Armor & 1 Magical Armor for every 3s it persists. On level-up or Takedown, the stats Doom grants are permanently increased by 20%.

loadout.name: From the Abyss
loadout.text: Restore 0.2/0.4/0.7/1% Max Health/s (Levels 1/6/11/16) while in Hero Combat or out of enemy vision.

loadout.name: Terror
loadout.text: Take 35% less damage from Minions and Monsters, and 25% less from Towers.

loadout.name: Iceskorn Talons
loadout.text: Glacial Colosseum:  Create an Ice Sheet around you for 8s. Allies on the sheet gain 12% Physical Power for 3s. They also gain 12% Movement Speed for 3s. Enemy Units on the sheet are Slowed by 10%.
loadout.plain: Drop an ice sheet where you dive in: allies on it gain power and speed, enemies on it are slowed. Use it when your team follows you into a fight.

duoLane.firstBlood: us (crunch on sparrow, in the duo lane)

evidence: 17/3/4, 31697 hero damage, the most in the game.

bullets: Forward Crunch is a dash, so casting it armed Berserker's Axe: the next basic attack within 3s dealt bonus damage and slowed by 55% for 1s.
After each ability, Cross Crunch empowers the next basic attack: bonus damage plus 1s off current cooldowns. Rapture adds damage to basic attacks on nearby enemies.
At top rank, 30 ability haste from Berserker's Axe and Vyzar Carapace cut Re-Crunch from 20s to about 15.4s, so repeating the last ability came back sooner.

coachLean.headline: Crunch took over their jungle and we pushed won fights into towers and an inhibitor; they never took a tower.

flags.text: Crunch ran the game: 17/3/4, 31697 hero damage, 75% kill participation.
Cashed 4 of 6 won fights within 90 seconds; towers 6-0, objective damage 25374 to 322.
Owned the river: buffs 14 to 4, all 3 seedlings, both Mini Primes and the Fangtooth.
Murdock and Steel gave up 0 early deaths while Sparrow and Riktor gave up 6.

focus.action: With one tank against their three, start fights on Steel's Shield Slam, chain Seismic Assault and Right Crunch, then fire Long Arm of the Law inside the lockdown.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Zero deaths, 10806 damage mitigated and 4132 healing, with 25% kill participation.
Wards fell to 11 against a usual 17.3; next game, ward ahead of each pit or tower push so the engage starts from sight.
8027fc05-883b-490c-970a-5d2080acd3d1: One death and 8.9 CS a minute against a usual 7.5, while the enemy carry died 6 times.
Damage sat at 517 a minute against a usual 1070; next game, open picks with Static Trap so Neural Disruptor follows up for the kill.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Soaked 25193 damage, mitigated 16846 and never died, with damage at 699 a minute against a usual 555.
Three kills on Aurora; next game, wait out Hoarfrost before committing to a trade with her.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Killed Wraith on the mid lane and later Aurora on the offlane, finishing with zero deaths.
Next game, hold Seismic Assault until Riktor's Skewer is spent; hero damage was 394 a minute, under a usual 761.
a8fc2666-226f-4cfe-8300-62adb007a1e0: Lived in their jungle: 110 of 221 jungle minions came from their side, plus 23259 objective damage.
Two of three deaths went to Wraith. Placed 0 wards with 1 cleared; if wards were equipped but unused, switch to sentry and sweep before invading.

buildCall.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Keep Tainted Charm into Kaelen's 7593 healing; next game test Xenia first, from the best all-matchup core at 67.2% in 58 games.
buildCall.8027fc05-883b-490c-970a-5d2080acd3d1: Lane record 47% into Sparrow, physical armor NOT built; add it third. Most played core: Lightning Hawk > Vanquisher > Imperator, 55.9% in 143 games.
buildCall.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Right call: 10389 of 14360 hero damage taken was magical, so Tainted Bastion fit; add Rapture third, from the 58.2% core in 564 games.
buildCall.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: On track: Combustion into Noxia matches the most played core into Wraith, 60.8% in 51 games; finish Wraith Leggings third.
buildCall.a8fc2666-226f-4cfe-8300-62adb007a1e0: Keep it: the damage came from Berserker's Axe, Forticus and Rapture; test Augmentation second, from the 60.6% core in 66 games.
